source: lab (real capture, background replaced by black = segmented)
pixel_convention: x right, y down, origin top-left pixel corner; values in px

camera.motion: static (phase correlation of table/leg region vs frame 0: |shift| < 0.2 px all frames)

perspective.view: camera looks obliquely down onto a table top; table far edge at top of image (y~242-250), near edge at y~418-433
perspective.note_vp: left side (502,242)->(435,418) and right side (823,292)->(852,432) converge above the image; far/near table edges are nearly horizontal
perspective.depth_ordering: larger image y on the table = closer to camera. Ball A path y 287->272 (slightly receding), ball B path y 256->301 (approaching camera after collision).
perspective.apparent_size: tennis-ball apparent diameter ~30-32 px everywhere (fit radius 13.7-14.5 at rest is biased low by pale rim/segmentation cut; 15-16.8 when moving includes blur). Visual edge reads: A at rest 32x30 px; B at rest ~32x30; B at frame 48 ~30 wide x 32 tall. Size change over the clip is within measurement noise (~1-2 px).
